title: POI Recommendation with LLM-Augmented Multi-Graph Learning and Contrastive Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.16407v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Point-of-interest (POI) recommendation models based on graph neural networks achieve strong performance by propagating collaborative signals over user-item interactions, yet they struggle with the cold-start problem, where items with few or no interactions are not represented. In this paper, we propose LLM-augmented Multi-Graph Contrastive Learning (LLM-MGCL), a multi-graph neural network that uses semantic and spatial information about items to extend the LightGCN backbone with two auxiliary item-item graphs: a semantic graph constructed from sentence embeddings of LLM-generated photo summaries and keywords, and a geographic graph derived from Haversine distances between business locations. Item embeddings are propagated over all three graphs in parallel, fused additively, and aligned across views through a bidirectional InfoNCE contrastive objective that connects behavioral, semantic, and spatial representations of the same items. translated_title: 基于大语言模型增强的多图学习与对比对齐的兴趣点推荐
translated_abstract: 摘要：基于图神经网络的兴趣点（POI）推荐模型通过在用户-物品交互上传播协同信号实现强性能，但它们在冷启动问题上表现不佳，即交互很少或没有交互的物品无法被有效表示。在本文中，我们提出了大语言模型增强的多图对比学习（LLM-MGCL），这是一种多图神经网络，利用物品的语义和空间信息，通过两个辅助物品-物品图扩展LightGCN骨干网络：一个是由大语言模型生成的图片摘要和关键词的句子嵌入构建的语义图，另一个是根据商业地点之间的哈弗辛距离推导出的地理图。物品嵌入在所有三个图上并行传播，通过加性融合，并通过双向InfoNCE对比目标跨视图对齐，连接同一物品的行为、语义和空间表示。
tldr: 本文提出LLM-MGCL，通过结合语义和地理信息的多图学习与对比对齐，有效解决了POI推荐中的冷启动问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLM-MGCL, which addresses cold-start in POI recommendation by integrating semantic and geographic information through multi-graph learning and contrastive alignment.
